what: size-ladder opendde 768 aa rung, re-measured on a quiet box to falsify the 1.42x outlier
why: The full ladder run at 11a92f686 read 768 aa at 277.6 s against a 195.9 s baseline, 1.42x, while every other rung came back FASTER. A co-tenant (worker:allm-safety, its own opendde 1024 rung at 247% CPU on card 2) was observed on the host at 04:56Z, which is when this rung was folding. Contention pushes a candidate-only measurement SLOWER against a baseline recorded elsewhere, so the convenient reading was that the outlier was contention. This re-run tests that instead of assuming it.

conditions.aiclk_note: card 0 held 1350 MHz across five samples taken DURING the folds; cards 1-3 idle at 800

verdict: REFUTED: the 1.42x was contention. The rung is FASTER with the merge, 0.94x, in line with its neighbours 640 (0.94x) and 896 (0.95x). Every one of the six supported rungs improves.
